svg.title: One UI Studio — four-screen Android theme concept
svg.desc: A concept contact sheet for the theme library, Theme Studio source editor, build review, and handoff to a separately implemented application bridge. Authoring scope includes semantic colors, fonts, icons, styles, variants, and per-app overrides. Quick settings are a conceptual preview. Framework, quick panel, and Settings compilation awaits current APK inputs. Exports and bridge integration are planned, with no generated artifacts or device application demonstrated. Device compatibility has not yet been verified.
svg.text: Your theme source. Your choice of bridge.
